attacks.label: Verify with the wrong public key

outcome.name: verification input substitution
outcome.description: Used an unrelated public key; no file written.

attacks.reason_after: the payload signature did not verify against the supplied public key. Either the key is not the sender's, or the signed bytes were modified

attacks.label: Verify with the wrong start secret

outcome.name: verification input substitution
outcome.description: Used a different derived start location; no file written. Wrong secrets, absent payloads and damaged framing can look alike.

attacks.reason_after: the manifest declares a 666-byte payload at start location 132,918, but the 4-byte length field read there decodes to 1,111,458,507, which cannot be used. It differs from the declared length in 12 of 32 bits. The length field is not covered by the signature, so this cannot say why: it is consistent with the file having been modified at that location, and also with a wrong start secret or depth, or with no payload having been embedded.

attacks.label: Corrupt the message

outcome.name: corrupt message section
outcome.description: Inverted byte 19 of the envelope's message section, which is covered by the signature.

attacks.reason_after: the payload signature did not verify against the supplied public key. Either the key is not the sender's, or the signed bytes were modified

attacks.label: Corrupt the signature

outcome.name: corrupt signature section
outcome.description: Inverted byte 128 of the envelope's signature section, which is covered by the signature.

attacks.reason_after: the payload signature did not verify against the supplied public key. Either the key is not the sender's, or the signed bytes were modified

attacks.label: Modify pixels outside the payload

outcome.name: modify pixels outside the payload
outcome.description: Inverted 64 samples starting at sample 63414, which is past the end of the payload region. Verification is expected to succeed: it authenticates the signed message, not the whole file.

details.limitation: AUTHENTIC means the signed verification record and the recovered message match, and the signature verified against the supplied public key. It does not mean every part of the cover media is unchanged, and it does not by itself reject a replayed file.

attacks.reason_after: the signature verified against the supplied public key and the recovered 38-byte message matches the digest that was signed
